blocks.text: Perhaps the word ἀκέραιος [akeraios] is more correctly referred, with Eustathius on Iliad 2, 855, to κεραΐζειν [keraizein], to harm, to injure, so that it denotes one who harms no one; from which it is transferred to anyone free from guile and deceit. Whoever wishes to know the opinions of others should consult SUICER, Thesaur. Ecclesiast. vol. 1, p. 155.
